availability_evidence: realtime_start_date is the archived release/vintage date; the observation date alone is never used for availability
method: GET named public download form; select all advertised vintage dates within declared bounds; POST levels, observation bounds, file_type=1 real-time periods and file_format=csv zipped CSV to the same series form
missing_or_revision_policy: No latest-series fallback, no backward fill, no guessed initial vintage. Require archived versions valid at each decision. Missing source closes the full six-source B contract; no unregistered reduced-feature replacement.

not_yet_admissible_sources.COT: Historical reports, revision notices and delayed releases identified; original/revised version intervals not yet verified. Direct metadata request returned HTTP 403. Tuesday position date is not Friday publication date.
not_yet_admissible_sources.GLD: Official historical archive identified; historical release timestamps and archived versions not yet verified. Direct metadata request returned HTTP 403.

predictor_availability_rule: Only after schema, vintage periods and publication-date evidence are validated. Use upper bound end of release date in America/New_York and wait one additional complete canonical XAU D1 interval; never backfill a first-created series into earlier decisions.
purpose: Inspect historical vintage availability for B only; retrieval is not predictor admission
